描述_EN: images of bodhisattva were used in temples and shrines, and were particularly popular among devotees. this gilt bronze figure represents a bodhisattva, a holy being who has obtained the final enlightenment and has chosen to return to the world to help humanity. the inscription on this example dates the object to ad 534 and mentions a placed called tangxian in north china where this piece was probably made. it is a very rare example of devotional image from the eastern wei dynasty (534-577). only two other examples of this type survive from the period, one in the freer gallery in washington dc, the other in a private japanese collection.
描述_ZN: 菩萨的形象被用于寺庙和神社，在信徒中特别受欢迎。 这幅鎏金铜像代表了一个菩萨，一个获得最终觉悟并选择返回世界帮助人类的圣人。 这个例子上的铭文可以追溯到公元534年，并提到了中国北部一个叫唐县的地方，这件作品可能就是在那里制作的。 这是一个非常罕见的东魏时期（534-577）的虔诚形象的例子。 这一时期只有另外两个例子存世，一个在华盛顿特区的Freer画廊，另一个在日本的私人收藏中。
